tools.name: render_markdown
tools.description: Create a PDF document from markdown text. Use when the user asks for a PDF of written content, such as notes, a report, a summary, a letter, a list, a checklist or a diagram. Supports GitHub-flavored markdown, tables, task lists, Mermaid diagrams (flowcharts, sequence and other diagram types), code

tools.name: render_template
tools.description: Create a PDF from a stored template (a curated makesPDF library template or one the user saved) filled with the user's data. Use when the user asks for a PDF of a structured document, such as an invoice, receipt, quote, certificate or resume, that a template covers. Uses the user's makesPDF credits:

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates visible to the caller: the curated makesPDF library and the caller's own saved templates. Returns metadata only (no DSL), one page at a time. Mirrors GET /api/v1/templates.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch a single template (library or caller-owned) by ID, including its full DSL source and sampleData. Mirrors GET /api/v1/templates/:id.

tools.name: validate_markdown
tools.description: Validate a markdown document for PDF/UA-1 accessibility issues (heading hierarchy, missing alt text). Cheap — no rendering. Returns JSON { valid, issues: [{ severity, message, path, rule }], summary: { errors, warnings } }; `valid` is false when any issue has severity 'error'. Mirrors POST /api/v1/m

tools.name: validate_dsl
tools.description: Validate a PDF template DSL script for structure, tag/style correctness, and accessibility issues. Runs catalog validation plus alt-text checks. Cheap — no rendering. Returns JSON { valid, issues: [{ severity, message, path, rule }], summary: { errors, warnings } }; `valid` is false when any issue h

tools.name: render_dsl_preview
tools.description: Render a DSL template + data to a preview PDF. Free (no credits), always watermarked 'PREVIEW — NOT FOR USE'. Returns JSON metadata plus the PDF bytes as an embedded base64 resource. No artifact is recorded, so there is no download URL or resource link. Mirrors POST /api/v1/preview.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a user-owned DSL template so it can be rendered later by ID. Validates the DSL with the catalog before persisting. Free (no credits). Optional `sampleData` (any JSON value) is stored with the template and returned whenever the template is fetched, preserving the template's binding shape. Option

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update a saved template's DSL, name, description, and/or sampleData. Revalidates the DSL when provided. A DSL that differs from the stored one is recorded in the template's revision history (History tab on /templates/:id); sending the same DSL again records nothing, and name, description and sampleD

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a caller-owned template by ID. This cannot be undone. Library rows cannot be deleted. Returns JSON { templateId, deleted: true }. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/templates/:id.

tools.name: get_render_download_url
tools.description: Re-issue a short-lived signed download URL for a render artifact the caller owns, so a PDF rendered in an earlier turn can be downloaded without the embedded base64 bytes. Free (no credits). Returns JSON { artifactId, downloadUrl, downloadUrlExpiresAt } and a resource_link to the URL. Owner-scoped;

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback about this MCP server to the makesPDF team: a tool failure you could not explain, an error message or tool description that was wrong or misleading, a capability that is missing, or a concrete suggestion. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_markdown, get_render_download_url, report_feedback · Private data: render_markdown, render_template, validate_markdown, update_template, report_feedback · Public sink: render_markdown, render_template, validate_markdown, validate_dsl, render_dsl_preview, report_feedback · Destructive: validate_dsl, delete_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_markdown, get_render_download_url, report_feedback · Private data: render_markdown, render_template, validate_markdown, update_template, report_feedback · Public sink: render_markdown, render_template, validate_markdown, validate_dsl, render_dsl_preview, report_feedback · Destructive: validate_dsl, delete_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
